title: Trust Your Food Again When Eating Out
text: Amazing. Is Patrick still here? Is he still here tonight? Patrick, this guy right here. Seriously, I just want to give a mic to you. Hi guys. Thank you so much. It's been such an honor the last 3 days. I just like reflecting on some of the conversations I've had. One of the conversations really stood out to me where it was two sisters and it was 10 years that went by that they haven't dined together in a restaurant because of her sister and her chronic illness. It's stories like that that really make me excited to participate and be able to provide this type of cuisine and have you guys be able to be out in a restaurant, enjoy the community. [Music] I love Cafe Gratitude. It's like a place I've been coming to for a long time. I love the food. I don't even have to think about the ingredients. I don't have to think about whether it's bad for me. It just feels so good to be able to go to a place, be able to trust it. I'm incredibly grateful for Cathic Gratitude, the creativity that they put into it. I want to thank Patrick. We got in contact with him and said, "Hey, you know, we have a child with special needs. We need like a table." And he got us our table. Just enjoy food together without having to worry about how it's going to affect us. Is amazing. It feels like the best party ever. [Music] There's a good vibe here and I think a lot of it begins with the food at Cafe Gratitude. Being able to metaphorically break bread with your people is oh it's so magical. I love it. Just really amazing souls. Everybody here has gone through the healing journey. So I feel like there's just an essence of gratitude here which is so perfect for the place. Right. Everyone has this beautiful light and is so joyous because they've decided to take back the reigns of their destiny and they're doing what they love. And just to just hear their stories and to share space with them has been so special. and to connect with this broader community of people who just love being here and being in communion with people in a world that is more fragmented than ever. People here remind me and offer me hope that the future can continue to look more interconnected and more peaceful and more loving because that is what we were all built to do. And it's beautiful to share that with people. It's it's unbelievable. Just super grateful for you and we're glad we can, you know, help the community. So, thank you so much. We love you guys so much. Thank you. [Music]
